verdict.rationale: As a managed ClickHouse database, ObsessionDB clearly lets users delete data in some form: a 'drop' is implied by its point-in-time recovery messaging, and agent data branches can be thrown away. It also runs standard ClickHouse SQL unchanged, and BYOC keeps data inside the customer's own cloud. However, nothing in the evidence documents retention controls or how long backups and query logs are kept, so the story is only glancingly covered. Missing for 10: documented retention/TTL policies, deletion guarantees covering backups and point-in-time-recovery snapshots, configurable retention for agent query logs, account- or org-level data deletion, independent corroboration.
